title: Mars investigation at SRI just down the hall from the remote viewing program

tellings.quote: same place where they they We found out later that the remote viewing program was just down the hall from the headquarters of the Mars investigation.

plain: In the 1980s, according to a physicist named John Brandenburg, the base of a research effort into possible signs of past life on Mars sat at SRI, the Stanford Research Institute in California, just down the hall from the government's remote viewing program, an effort to use psychics to describe distant places. Brandenburg, who worked on the Mars side, tells Michels they only "found out later" who their neighbors were, which hints that the two efforts may have been linked.
